title: Chapter 75 The Lord Of The Heavenly Court, Mu Chen Joins
content:
Chapter 75 The Lord Of The Heavenly Court, Mu Chen Joins

Inside the Heavenly Palace.

At this time, the Lord of the Heavenly Palace, Mu Chen, felt extremely complicated.

The brother who had lived and died together in the past was not only fine now, but also broke through.

Did the other party deceive him?

His failure was terrible, but his brother's success was even more heartbreaking.

At this moment, two figures appeared in front of Mu Chen.

It was Lu Daosheng and Qin Yi.

"Mu Chen, long time no see."

Seeing Mu Chen, Qin Yi took the initiative to greet him.

Hearing this, Mu Chen glanced at Qin Yi, then glanced at Lu Daosheng beside him, then snorted coldly, turned his head away, and ignored him.

Seeing this, Qin Yi's face was a little embarrassed, but he soon understood.

Then, Qin Yi told Mu Chen what happened to him.

When he learned that Lu Daosheng beside Qin Yi not only restored Qin Yi's strength in the past, but also made him reach a higher level, Mu Chen was shocked and his face was full of disbelief.

"Qin Yi, you didn't lie to me?"

Hearing this, Qin Yi directly released his divine realm aura.

"Look, does this realm look fake?"

Feeling the divine realm aura that was countless times stronger than himself, Muchen looked solemn, and then he carefully looked at Lu Daosheng beside Qin Yi.

At this time, Lu Daosheng was also looking at him.

"This, senior, can you help me recover?"

He didn't ask for further progress, as long as he could recover to the way he was in the past.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I can help you recover, then what?"

Hearing this, Muchen also knew what the other party meant. He was silent for a moment, took a deep breath, and then said, "As long as you can help me recover, I, Muchen, am willing to follow you."

Although he was also very disgusted with following others, it depended on the situation.

Now, he was almost dead, why did he care so much.

And a strong man who could do this, wasn't it worth his Muchen's following?

Hearing Muchen's answer, Lu Daosheng nodded.

It's comfortable to deal with such a smart person.

Then Lu Daosheng didn't hesitate any more and gave Muchen and Qin Yi the same treatment.

After all, their situations were the same. The battle that year left only a remnant soul, and this remnant soul was left before the war, just to leave some hope for future generations.

Now, it seems that it is not necessary.

As for the inheritance of the Heavenly Court, it seems that there is none, because the source of the Heavenly Court is the Human Emperor Palace, but it was separated later.

So there is only inheritance in the Human Emperor Palace.

I don't know how long it took, Muchen also recovered, and his cultivation was the same as Qin Yi, and he reached the realm of God.

Feeling the surging power in his body, Muchen was extremely excited and wanted to laugh wildly on the spot.

However, Lu Daosheng's light cough interrupted him.

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Mu Chen reacted and said without hesitation: "I, Mu Chen, am willing to follow you."

At this point, only the one from the Saint Gate was left.

At this moment, a voice suddenly came from a distance.

"Come quickly, there seems to be something here!"

"Chief Emperor, run slower, be careful of danger."

Hearing the familiar voice, Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows slightly, it turned out to be Gu Chen Yunqi and the Undead Emperor Clan.

Looking at Lu Daosheng's expression, Mu Chen hurriedly said: "Sir, do you recognize them?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Two of them are my people."

Hearing this, Mu Chen looked slightly surprised, and then waved his hand quickly.

Instantly, a restriction in the distance slowly dissipated.

Even if a strong man in the realm of the Heavenly Monarch was accidentally killed by that restriction.

After all, this is the Heavenly Court.

The restriction was naturally set by the top strong men in the Heavenly Court.

Not long after, a group of figures slowly emerged from a distance.

Seeing the figures of Lu Daosheng and the other two, Gu Chen and the others were stunned for a moment, and then hurriedly said: "Be careful! There are people in there!"

Suddenly, everyone looked at Lu Daosheng and the other two with vigilance.

And at this moment, Yunqi suddenly said: "Old brother, did you find that person a bit like our city lord?"

Hearing this, Gu Chen was stunned for a moment, and then carefully looked at Lu Daosheng.

Because it was still a little far away, and the ban had not completely dissipated, it looked a little blurry.

But after Yunqi said this, Gu Chen felt more and more that it was a bit like.

Will the city lord appear here?

Just when the two were confused, Lu Daosheng's voice suddenly sounded.

"What are you doing there?"

Hearing this, Gu Chen and the others were stunned, and immediately reacted.

It's really the city lord.

And the people of the Undead Emperor Clan were also extremely shocked.

Isn't the city lord of this deserted city not coming? How could he appear here?

Then everyone hurried forward.

"Lord City Lord, why are you here?"

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Yunqi and the others asked in confusion.

"Why, can't I come?"

Lu Daosheng smiled.

Hearing this, the two hurriedly shook their heads, "Of course you can come, but..."

They thought that the Lord City Lord would keep an eye on Lu Xue, could it be that Miss Lu Xue has already.

As if seeing through their thoughts, Lu Daosheng said directly: "Lu Xue and the others have returned to the deserted city."

Hearing this, the two were shocked again.

As expected of the Lord City Lord's daughter, this speed is really fast.

At this time, Gu Chen suddenly looked at Di Ming, the patriarch of the Immortal Emperor Clan.

"Patriarch Di, what's wrong with you?"

At this time, Di Ming looked at the two people beside Lu Daosheng with a look as if he had seen a ghost, his eyes full of disbelief.

"You, you two are?"

Mu Chen glanced at Di Ming and chuckled: "Oh, I didn't expect you to be alive?"

Hearing this, Di Ming was shocked and said: "It's really you two, haven't you two already?!"

The Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, the Lord of the Heavenly Court.

Shouldn't these two have died in that war long ago?

Even if they left some tricks back then, it shouldn't be like this.

Looking at the aura of the two, it seems to be stronger than that year.

Hearing this, Mu Chen and Qin Yi smiled and didn't answer.

They don't look down on the Immortal Emperor Clan. That year, the war was not only aimed at their human race, but also the entire Ten Thousand Spirits Realm. But the Immortal Emperor Clan and the Longevity Immortal Clan didn't even show their faces.

They are just some rats.

As if he saw the irony in the eyes of the two, Emperor Ming was very tactful and did not ask any more questions.

But at this time, he looked at Lu Daosheng again.

Why would the Lord of Desolate City stand in front of the two people, and why did these two people stand behind him like the Lord of Desolate City's younger brothers?

For a moment, a very unrealistic guess appeared in Emperor Ming's mind.

Could it be that these two have joined Desolate City?

Impossible, impossible, who are the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace and the Lord of the Heavenly Court? They dare to fight against enemies several times stronger than the Ten Thousand Spirits.

How could they follow others? It must be an illusion.

However, at this time, Qin Yi said to Lu Daosheng: "My lord, let's go to the Holy Gate first. I feel that something seems to have happened there."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, then gave Mu Chen a look, and then looked at Gu Chen and Yun Qi.

Mu Chen immediately understood and waved his hand.

Two beams of light flew directly towards the two people.

"Thank you for the gift, senior!"

Gu Chen and the others hurriedly thanked him, and this trip was not in vain.

Moreover, these two terrifying beings actually called their city lord "sir", which means they have also joined the deserted city.

On the side, Di Ming was completely stunned at this moment.

"Am I dreaming?"
